summary: Master governance of digital platforms and data sharing with practical tools, controls, and reporting. Enrol to improve compliance and accountability.
lede: Digital platform governance sets how teams make decisions, control access, and manage shared data across platforms. This training is for professionals working in platform, data, compliance, or information governance who need to assess governance gaps and create workable controls for data exchange. Participants map data flows, define classification and access rules, review audit evidence, and build reporting artefacts and an implementation roadmap.
audienceIntro: This course is designed for professionals who already support data, platform, compliance, or information governance work and now need a stronger operating model for digital sharing and control.
prerequisites: You should come prepared with a working understanding of digital platform operations, data-sharing processes, or information governance duties. A laptop is recommended for workshop exercises, and familiarity with policy documents, access logs, data dictionaries, or governance dashboards will help you complete the applied activities more effectively.
topics: Legal risk for AI, data and digital services
